slides.title: What is Deploy App
slides.html:
Deploy App lets you access your unit's C2 server easily.

  • You can easily add, manage and remove users from your server, in 0-2 minutes a job.
  • Spawning a Deploy App instance to cloud or on-prem is an automated job taking ten minutes. No manual configuration. Deploy App contains apps integrated into it. Many apps can be developed to work with Deploy App.

slides.title: Manage users
slides.html:
Add users with QR-codes or links with ease. Manage their role and remove them by need.

  • When invited, incoming users get a client certificate to their device.
  • The client cert will be their identity and access to your unit's Deploy App server and services. Client certs are tried and true high-security tool. Chances are that eg. your usual enterprise identity card hosts one.

slides.title: Developed to be augmented
slides.html:
• App developers can make their app to work with Deploy App.
  • This aims to simplify how you get your app to soldiers, both from soldiers' and your viewpoints. Familiarize yourself on how to use Deploy App from the following guide.
